title: Algeria (African Startup & Young Innovators Financing Fund) — pan-African startup financing, 2025
description: "Algeria committed USD 1 billion to finance African startups — announced 21 October 2025 by Kamel Rezig, Minister of Foreign Trade and Export Promotion, at the African Ministerial Meeting on the sidelines of UNCTAD16 (Geneva). The money flows through the African Startup and Young Innovators Financing Fund, launched by President Tebboune in September 2025, targeting technology, education, healthcare and humanitarian projects with strong social/economic impact."

title: Mobilis, Djezzy, Ooredoo — Algeria 5G licences, 2025
description: "Algeria has launched a landmark 5G rollout after awarding $492 million in licences to Mobilis, Djezzy and Ooredoo ... unveiling a national 5G rollout whose first three licences, awarded to Mobilis, Djezzy and Ooredoo, are worth $492 million (DZD 63.9 billion). The launch is one of North Africa's largest telecom investments this decade." The six-year national plan begins with eight pilot wilayas before full nationwide coverage by 2031.
